createTable.remarks: Bearer tokens for the external REST API. No FK -- matches this codebase's actor-reference-column convention; the owning actor's key rows are deleted at the application layer (ApiKeyPort.deleteAllForActor), not via DB cascade.

column.name: actor_id
column.remarks: Owning actor. References user_information(id), no FK

column.name: key_hash
column.remarks: SHA-256 hash of the raw key; the raw key itself is never stored

column.name: key_prefix
column.remarks: First characters of the raw key in the clear, for a human-readable list without re-showing the secret

column.name: label
column.remarks: Optional caller-supplied name for the key

column.name: revoked_at
column.remarks: NULL means active; set once the owner revokes the key
